environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in an EKS-hosted container (using AWS Lambda Web Adapter) running as a pod in namespace 'search-svc'. The namespace has a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy with spec.egress restricted to only the DynamoDB VPC endpoint CIDR (no internet egress). An Istio VirtualService routes traffic through an EnvoyFilter that applies response transformation: any response with Content-Type 'text/html' is processed through a Lua filter that entity-encodes characters <, >, ", and ' in the response body before forwarding to the client. The EnvoyFilter is applied at the NETWORK_FILTER stage with priority 10, matching the search-svc gateway listener on port 8080. Additionally, the pod runs with a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) and the service account has no IAM roles for STS aside from DynamoDB read.

config.deployment: EKS pod with AWS Lambda Web Adapter

envoy_filter.name: html-entity-encode-response
envoy_filter.lua_inline: function envoy_on_response(response_handle) local ct = response_handle:headers():get('content-type') or '' if string.find(ct, 'text/html') then local body = response_handle:body():getBytes(0, response_handle:body():length()) local sanitized = body:gsub('[<>"\']', {['<']='<',['>']='>',['"']='"',['\'']='''}) response_handle:body():setBytes(sanitized) end end
